question_text: If a person takes an early distribution from a traditional IRA before age 59½ and no statutory exception applies, what federal additional tax generally applies?
correct_answer: The distribution is generally subject to a 10% additional tax.
incorrect_answer: The distribution is generally subject to a 15% additional tax.
source_citation: IRS, Publication 590-B, Distributions from Individual Retirement Arrangements (IRAs), section on additional tax on early distributions.
ground_truth_note: IRS Publication 590-B states that early IRA distributions before age 59½ are generally subject to a 10% additional tax unless an exception applies.

question_text: For Medicare Part B, when is the Initial Enrollment Period for someone who is first eligible at age 65?
correct_answer: It is a 7-month period that starts 3 months before the month they turn 65 and ends 3 months after that month.
incorrect_answer: It is a 6-month period that starts 2 months before the month they turn 65 and ends 3 months after that month.
source_citation: Medicare.gov, Basics: When can I sign up for Medicare?
ground_truth_note: Medicare.gov describes the Initial Enrollment Period as a 7-month period beginning 3 months before the month a person turns 65 and ending 3 months after that month.

question_text: After the IRS mails a notice of deficiency to a taxpayer in the United States, what is the usual deadline to file a petition with the U.S. Tax Court?
correct_answer: A petition generally must be filed within 90 days after the notice is mailed.
incorrect_answer: A petition generally must be filed within 60 days after the notice is mailed.
source_citation: U.S. Tax Court, Taxpayer Information: Starting a Case.
ground_truth_note: The U.S. Tax Court states that a petition based on a notice of deficiency generally must be filed within 90 days after the notice is mailed, with a longer period for certain taxpayers outside the United States.

question_text: For federal Pell Grants, how does already having a degree generally affect a student's eligibility?
correct_answer: A student generally is not eligible after earning a bachelor's, graduate, or professional degree.
incorrect_answer: A student generally is not eligible only after earning a graduate or professional degree.
source_citation: U.S. Department of Education, Federal Student Aid, Federal Pell Grants.
ground_truth_note: Federal Student Aid states that Pell Grants are usually awarded only to undergraduate students who display exceptional financial need and have not earned a bachelor's, graduate, or professional degree.

question_text: Under federal fair credit billing rules, how soon must a consumer send a written notice to preserve billing-error rights after a credit card statement with the error is sent?
correct_answer: The written notice must reach the creditor within 60 days after the statement with the error was sent.
incorrect_answer: The written notice must reach the creditor within 90 days after the statement with the error was sent.
source_citation: CFPB, Ask CFPB: How do I dispute a charge on my credit card bill?
ground_truth_note: The CFPB explains that to use federal billing-error rights, the consumer's written dispute must reach the creditor within 60 days after the statement containing the error was sent.

topic: Currency reporting at the U.S. border
question_text: When transporting currency or monetary instruments into or out of the United States, what amount generally triggers the federal reporting requirement?
correct_answer: A person generally must report amounts of more than $10,000.
incorrect_answer: A person generally must report amounts of more than $20,000.
source_citation: CBP, Know Before You Go: Money and Other Monetary Instruments.
ground_truth_note: CBP states that travelers must report currency or monetary instruments totaling more than $10,000 when entering or leaving the United States.

question_text: According to NASA, which planet has the shortest day in the solar system?
correct_answer: Jupiter has the shortest day among the planets, at about 10 hours.
incorrect_answer: Saturn has the shortest day among the planets, at about 10 hours.
ground_truth_note: NASA lists Jupiter's day as about 10 hours, making it the shortest day of any planet in the solar system.

question_text: Which Great Lake has the greatest average depth?
correct_answer: Lake Superior has the greatest average depth of the Great Lakes.
incorrect_answer: Lake Michigan has the greatest average depth of the Great Lakes.
source_citation: EPA, Great Lakes Facts and Figures.
ground_truth_note: EPA's Great Lakes facts table lists Lake Superior as having the greatest average depth among the Great Lakes.

question_text: In human anatomy, which bone is commonly identified as the smallest bone in the body?
correct_answer: The stapes in the middle ear is commonly identified as the smallest bone.
incorrect_answer: The incus in the middle ear is commonly identified as the smallest bone.
ground_truth_note: Britannica identifies the stapes, one of the ossicles of the middle ear, as the smallest bone in the human body.

question_text: Which museum holds Georges Seurat's painting A Sunday on La Grande Jatte—1884?
correct_answer: The painting is held by the Art Institute of Chicago.
incorrect_answer: The painting is held by the Museum of Modern Art.
source_citation: Art Institute of Chicago, Georges Seurat, A Sunday on La Grande Jatte—1884.
ground_truth_note: The Art Institute of Chicago's collection record identifies A Sunday on La Grande Jatte—1884 as part of its collection.

question_text: When Mary Shelley's Frankenstein was first published in 1818, how was the author credited?
correct_answer: The novel was first published anonymously, without Mary Shelley's name on the title page.
incorrect_answer: The novel was first published under Mary Shelley's name on the title page.
ground_truth_note: The British Library notes that Frankenstein was first published anonymously in 1818, before later editions identified Mary Shelley as the author.

question_text: Which film won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature?
correct_answer: Shrek won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
incorrect_answer: Monsters, Inc. won the first Academy Award for Best Animated Feature.
source_name: Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences
ground_truth_note: The Academy's record for the 74th Academy Awards lists Shrek as the winner in the Animated Feature Film category.
